preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of the specified substances: 'water', 'slime', 'sludge', or 'air'.

postconditions.expression: any(word in str.lower() for word in ['water', 'wet', 'wash']) and not any(phrase in str.lower() for phrase in ['i don\'t know', 'slime'])
postconditions.description: If any of the words 'water', 'wet', or 'wash' are present, the output must be 'water' unless 'slime' phrases are also present.

postconditions.expression: any(phrase in str.lower() for phrase in ['i don\'t know', 'slime']) and not any(word in str.lower() for word in ['water', 'wet', 'wash'])
postconditions.description: If any of the phrases 'I don't know' or 'slime' are present, the output must be 'slime' unless 'water' words are also present.

postconditions.expression: any(word in str.lower() for word in ['water', 'wet', 'wash']) and any(phrase in str.lower() for phrase in ['i don\'t know', 'slime'])
postconditions.description: If both 'water' words and 'slime' phrases are present, the output must be 'sludge'.

postconditions.expression: not any(word in str.lower() for word in ['water', 'wet', 'wash']) and not any(phrase in str.lower() for phrase in ['i don\'t know', 'slime'])
postconditions.description: If neither 'water' words nor 'slime' phrases are present, the output must be 'air'.
